text: Jordan's dashboard rework got contradictory criticism from Marcus (now "too safe" after last week's opposite complaint), leaving Jordan feeling dismissed and unable to react beyond a resigned nod, while Lena's sympathetic look only underscored the sting. Afterward Jordan withdrew—canceling dinner with Mika, sitting alone in the dark apartment unable to eat or engage even with Pepper—recognizing the familiar retreat-into-the-shell pattern triggered by having work dismissed. No real decision was made beyond continuing to iterate on the dashboard; Jordan mostly registers guilt over shutting Mika out and frustration that naming the pattern doesn't stop it.
